MonthlyˆstatementsˆYourˆmonthlyˆstatementˆisˆreadyˆwithinˆ3ˆafterˆtheˆendˆofˆeachˆmonth.ˆWe'llˆnotifyˆyouˆwhenˆit'sˆavailable.ˆ##ˆDownloadˆaˆstatementˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆDocuments,ˆthenˆStatements,ˆandˆchooseˆtheˆmonth.ˆStatementsˆareˆPDFs.ˆ##ˆHowˆfarˆbackˆSevenˆyearsˆofˆstatementsˆareˆavailableˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆStatementˆdatesˆStatementsˆcoverˆaˆcalendarˆmonthˆandˆcloseˆonˆtheˆlastˆdayˆofˆtheˆmonth.ˆTheˆstatementˆdateˆmattersˆforˆdisputesˆaboutˆunauthorizedˆtransactions,ˆwhichˆmustˆbeˆreportedˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆstatementˆtheyˆfirstˆappearˆon.ˆ##ˆPaperˆstatementsˆWeˆdon'tˆmailˆpaperˆstatements,ˆandˆthere'sˆnoˆfeeˆforˆanyˆstatementˆ($0.00).ˆ##ˆSavingsˆPocketsˆPocketˆbalancesˆandˆinterestˆappearˆonˆtheˆsameˆstatementˆasˆyourˆmainˆbalance.ˆ##ˆSomethingˆlooksˆwrongˆIfˆaˆstatementˆshowsˆaˆtransactionˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognize,ˆtapˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆtoˆseeˆtheˆmerchantˆdetails,ˆandˆdisputeˆitˆifˆyouˆdidn'tˆmakeˆit.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="close-statements">
StatementsˆafterˆclosingˆAfterˆyouˆcloseˆyourˆaccount,ˆyouˆcanˆstillˆsignˆinˆandˆdownloadˆstatementsˆforˆ90ˆdays.ˆ##ˆDownloadˆthemˆbeforeˆyouˆgoˆWeˆrecommendˆdownloadingˆanyˆstatementsˆandˆtaxˆformsˆyouˆmightˆneedˆbeforeˆyouˆclose.ˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆDocuments.ˆ##ˆAfterˆthatˆOnceˆtheˆdownloadˆperiodˆends,ˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆin.ˆMessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen,ˆorˆemailˆus,ˆandˆwe'llˆsendˆtheˆstatementsˆyouˆneed.ˆWeˆkeepˆrecordsˆforˆsevenˆyears.ˆ##ˆTaxˆformsˆIfˆyouˆearnedˆatˆleastˆ$10.00ˆinˆinterestˆinˆtheˆyearˆyouˆclosed,ˆweˆstillˆsendˆyourˆ1099-INTˆbyˆJanuaryˆ31.ˆ##ˆVerificationˆlettersˆAccountˆverificationˆlettersˆareˆonlyˆavailableˆforˆopenˆaccounts.ˆ##ˆCardˆandˆtransactionˆhistoryˆYourˆstatementsˆlistˆeveryˆtransaction,ˆfee,ˆinterestˆpaymentˆandˆdisputeˆcreditˆforˆtheˆmonth,ˆsoˆthey'reˆusuallyˆallˆyouˆneedˆforˆrecords,ˆtaxesˆorˆaˆloanˆapplicationˆelsewhere.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="support-no-advice">
FinancialˆadviceˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆexplainˆhowˆTallowbrookˆproductsˆwork,ˆbutˆweˆcan'tˆgiveˆfinancial,ˆinvestment,ˆtaxˆorˆlegalˆadvice.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcan'tˆhelpˆwithˆ-ˆWhetherˆtoˆinvest,ˆsaveˆorˆpayˆdownˆdebtˆ-ˆWhichˆstocks,ˆfundsˆorˆcryptocurrenciesˆtoˆbuyˆorˆsellˆ-ˆHowˆmuchˆofˆyourˆmoneyˆtoˆkeepˆinˆsavingsˆ-ˆHowˆtoˆreportˆinterestˆorˆotherˆincomeˆonˆyourˆtaxesˆ-ˆLegalˆquestionsˆaboutˆwills,ˆdivorceˆorˆdisputesˆwithˆotherˆpeopleˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcanˆhelpˆwithˆ-ˆHowˆourˆsavingsˆratesˆandˆSavingsˆPocketsˆworkˆ-ˆFeesˆandˆlimitsˆonˆeachˆplan,ˆsoˆyouˆcanˆdecideˆwhichˆsuitsˆyouˆ-ˆYourˆstatementsˆandˆtaxˆformsˆ##ˆWhereˆtoˆgetˆadviceˆForˆadviceˆaboutˆyourˆsituation,ˆtalkˆtoˆaˆqualifiedˆfinancialˆadviser,ˆtaxˆprofessionalˆorˆlawyer.ˆ##ˆInvestingˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆofferˆinvestmentˆorˆbrokerageˆaccounts.ˆSeeˆ"Investingˆandˆcryptocurrency".ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
